notes:
Android microphone configuration fix. Adds MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS alongside RECORD_AUDIO, which Chromium WebView checks before exposing/selecting an audio capture device. It is an install-time Android permission, not another microphone recording permission prompt. Existing RECORD_AUDIO runtime request and unlocked foreground checks remain.

Adds an explicit native configuration check before audio grants. Diagnostics now distinguish failure to acquire the microphone from failure to start a recorder after acquiring it. Picker fix, screenshot protection and Friend mode are unchanged.

The missing manifest permission is confirmed and matches Chromium source and reported WebView failures. This has not been verified on a physical Android device. Update over the existing app; do not uninstall.

Story videos now accept up to 50 MB (50,000,000 bytes), still 90 seconds, 3 active stories, 24 hours. Photos keep their existing limit. Android update checks retry on app resume, network return and every 5 minutes while visible. The top download button stays available to check manually even when no update has been found. This fixes the native once-per-session check latch and adds recovery from failed checks. Download package, version and signing certificate verification remain unchanged.
